Backup se osụhọde enim ofuri file se ekpụhọde oto utom akpatre. App edi andise storage: ku kama enye n̄kpọ enwen ndien ku buana enye ke otu mme utom.
Nọ storage kiet se mme version backup edidụn̄.
Pattern kiet ke line kiet. Enyi nte bin ekpọn̄ folder oro. *.tmp ekpọn̄ mme file se odude.

Select the source to import media from — for example an SD card, camera folder, or phone over FTPS.
Kama {DATE:format} man sin usen se ekpụhọde file. Format edi pattern usen .NET, uwụtn̄kpọ yyyy-MM-dd.

Kpọn̄ mme file se ekpụhọde mbemiso (yyyy-MM-dd):
Nọ storage kiet se mme defais edinam sync. Ofuri defais ekpe kama ebiet kiet ye password kiet.
Folder eke repository:
Buana folder se akade ye FTPS explicit ye certificate se enye ikpọhọde onyụn̄ sin. Ke ini utom asụhọde, FTPS client ke network fo ekeme ndi yịre.
Ini, minute:
Server eye tre ke mme minute emi. 30 edi se esiwakde ndi kama.
Fiak version kiet oto storage backup. Sat storage ye password kiet nte utom backup.
Load mme version
Fiak n̄kpọ do:
Emi edi version se ese mbemiso. Enye ekeme ndi copy, kpụhọ ndien sio mme file, ke sync n̄ko. Nim backup fo mbemiso afo anam utom.
Ke ini edomode udiana, ema okut certificate se enye ikpọhọde onyụn̄ sin.
Ema nim enye ke field hex ke certificate. Udiana enwen eyeyime enye.

Domo mme fingerprint emi ye mme eke afo oyomde. Edieke ema sana, tuk OK ini kiet eken. Edieke mmisana, ekeme ndidi attack man-in-the-middle, midighe software antivirus midighe MDM ke biọkọ udiana emi.
